Marissa & Hannah — looping you in for AP and legal checklist items. Marissa, can you confirm whether we need an additional tax form for states where Redwood has nexus? Hannah, if you could note any missing proof-of-formation docs we should capture (certificate of incorporation, good standing), that would be helpful.

- We will create the vendor master and send a confirmation once PO path is validated

Hi Alex (and Monica),

Quick AP checklist from our side:
- W-9: received and attached to the record — good.
- Banking/ACH: we do not accept banking details over email. If AOA would like ACH setup, I will send a secure vendor onboarding link for bank details and an ACH authorization form.
- Invoicing: ap-invoices@redwood.com is our central mailbox. Please be sure each invoice includes the PO number and vendor remit name exactly as "AOA Industries, Inc." to avoid delays.
- State tax forms: Monica, for CA nexus we will request Form 590 or other state tax forms only if finance flags an issue; for now W-9 is sufficient.

Also, Alex — please confirm whether invoices will be issued from maria.santos@aoa-industries.com or from a shared AR mailbox. If you use a shared mailbox, please provide that address so we can whitelist it against our invoicing intake automation.

If you prefer, I can open the secure link and pre-populate the company name so you only need to drop bank docs. Reply "Send secure ACH link" and I’ll initiate that.

Thanks,
